payload.summary: New longitudinal quality evidence: four matched pairs/72 scheduled turns completed with 8 planned interruptions, no other timeout. Both arms 120/120 primary, 52/52 intent and 9216/9216 exploratory stress. DIP used 571 completed MCP calls, 9,977,526 reported input tokens and 204,686 output tokens versus baseline 5,592,412 input and 133,438 output (missing interrupted-turn usage excluded). Median summed turn duration was 1859.8s with DIP vs1035.8s baseline; includes concurrent worker time twice, not elapsed completion time. Candidate overhead includes semantic fragmentation, duplicate Markdown/ledger memory and scope contention; no causal decomposition or optimization yet.
payload.next: Profile and reduce management overhead without weakening memory, fencing or snapshot-based verification; retain the current datasets unchanged as baselines.
